rewritten_query:
with ss_cust as (
  select distinct ss_customer_sk as cust_sk
  from store_sales, date_dim, item
  where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    and d_year = 2002
    and d_moy between 3 and 6
    and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    and i_category in ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    and i_manager_id between 72 and 81
    and ss_sales_price / ss_list_price between 0.9 and 1.0
),
ws_cust as (
  select distinct ws_bill_customer_sk as cust_sk
  from web_sales, date_dim, item
  where ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    and d_year = 2002
    and d_moy between 3 and 6
    and ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
    and i_category in ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    and i_manager_id between 72 and 81
    and ws_sales_price / ws_list_price between 0.9 and 1.0
),
cs_cust as (
  select distinct cs_ship_customer_sk as cust_sk
  from catalog_sales, date_dim, item
  where cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    and d_year = 2002
    and d_moy between 3 and 6
    and cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
    and i_category in ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    and i_manager_id between 72 and 81
    and cs_sales_price / cs_list_price between 0.9 and 1.0
),
wscs as (
  select cust_sk from ws_cust
  union
  select cust_sk from cs_cust
)
select cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, count(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, count(*) cnt3, cd_dep_count, count(*) cnt4, cd_dep_employed_count, count(*) cnt5, cd_dep_college_count, count(*) cnt6
from customer c
join ss_cust on c.c_customer_sk = ss_cust.cust_sk
join wscs on c.c_customer_sk = wscs.cust_sk
join customer_address ca
  on c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
 and ca.ca_county in ('Baldwin County','Cocke County','Elko County','Geauga County','Marengo County')
 and c.c_birth_month in (6, 7)
join customer_demographics
  on customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
 and customer_demographics.cd_marital_status in ('U', 'S')
 and customer_demographics.cd_education_status in ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary')
 and customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'F'
group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count
order by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count
limit 100;

              from store_sales, item iss, date_dim d1
              where ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk

                and i_manager_id between 14 and 23
                and cs_wholesale_cost between 78 and 98
              intersect all
              select iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
              from web_sales, item iws, date_dim d3
              where ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
                and ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
                and ws_wholesale_cost between 78 and 98
                and d3.d_year between 1998 and 2000) ia) x
    on it.i_brand_id = x.brand_id
   and it.i_class_id = x.class_id
   and it.i_category_id = x.category_id
),

        from store_sales
        join (select d_date_sk from date_dim where d_year between 1998 and 2000) d
          on ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        where ss_wholesale_cost between 78 and 98

        select sum(cs_quantity * cs_list_price), count(cs_quantity * cs_list_price)
        from catalog_sales
        join (select d_date_sk from date_dim where d_year between 1998 and 2000) d
          on cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk

        select sum(ws_quantity * ws_list_price), count(ws_quantity * ws_list_price)

WITH d1 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 8 AND d_year = 2001
), d2 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 8 AND 10 AND d_year = 2001
), sr_ss AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk,
         SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit_agg,
         SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss_agg,
         COUNT(*) AS pair_cnt
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN store_returns sr
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
   AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  JOIN d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk
)
SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name,
       SUM(f.store_sales_profit_agg) AS store_sales_profit,
       SUM(f.store_returns_loss_agg) AS store_returns_loss,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit * f.pair_cnt) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM sr_ss f
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = f.ss_item_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = f.ss_store_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs
  ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = f.ss_customer_sk
 AND cs.cs_item_sk = f.ss_item_sk
JOIN d2 AS d3 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name

WITH catalog_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_order_number, cs_warehouse_sk, cs_sold_date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 69 AND 88
),
catalog_returns_base AS (
    SELECT cr_item_sk, cr_order_number, cr_reason_sk
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_reason_sk = 11
),
item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Home'
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 67
),
warehouse_all AS (
    SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_state
    FROM warehouse
),
date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-03-27' AND DATE '1998-05-26'
)
SELECT min(warehouse.w_state), min(item.i_item_id), min(catalog_sales.cs_item_sk), min(catalog_sales.cs_order_number), min(catalog_returns.cr_item_sk), min(catalog_returns.cr_order_number)
FROM catalog_sales_filtered catalog_sales
JOIN catalog_returns_base catalog_returns
    ON catalog_sales.cs_order_number = catalog_returns.cr_order_number
    AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = catalog_returns.cr_item_sk
JOIN item_filtered item
    ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
JOIN warehouse_all warehouse
    ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk

WITH month_bounds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 1 AS lower_seq,
                    d_month_seq + 3 AS upper_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy = 6
),
my_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT branch_sales.customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
                    branch_sales.c_current_addr_sk
    FROM (
        SELECT catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
               customer.c_current_addr_sk
        FROM catalog_sales
        JOIN item
          ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
         AND item.i_category = 'Electronics'
         AND item.i_class = 'portable'
        JOIN date_dim
          ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
         AND date_dim.d_moy = 6
         AND date_dim.d_year = 2002
        JOIN customer
          ON customer.c_customer_sk = catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk
         AND customer.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1991
        WHERE catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100
        UNION ALL
        SELECT web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
               customer.c_current_addr_sk
        FROM web_sales
        JOIN item
          ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
         AND item.i_category = 'Electronics'
         AND item.i_class = 'portable'
        JOIN date_dim
          ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
         AND date_dim.d_moy = 6
         AND date_dim.d_year = 2002
        JOIN customer
          ON customer.c_customer_sk = web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk
         AND customer.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1991
        WHERE web_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100
    ) branch_sales
),
my_revenue AS (
    SELECT mc.c_customer_sk,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM my_customers mc
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON mc.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
     AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL','AR','FL','MN','MO','NC','NY','OK','PA','WI')
    JOIN store s
      ON ca.ca_county = s.s_county
     AND ca.ca_state = s.s_state
     AND s.s_state IN ('AL','AR','FL','MN','MO','NC','NY','OK','PA','WI')
    JOIN store_sales
      ON mc.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
     AND store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100
    JOIN date_dim
      ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT lower_seq FROM month_bounds)
                                   AND (SELECT upper_seq FROM month_bounds)
    GROUP BY mc.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT CAST((revenue / 50) AS int) AS segment,
       COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
       CAST((revenue / 50) AS int) * 50 AS segment_base
FROM my_revenue
GROUP BY CAST((revenue / 50) AS int)
ORDER BY segment, num_customers
LIMIT 100;

WITH all_sales AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
  FROM (
    SELECT dd.d_year, it.i_brand_id, it.i_class_id, it.i_category_id, it.i_manufact_id,
           cs.cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt,
           cs.cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount,0.0) AS sales_amt
    FROM (SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_order_number, cs_quantity, cs_list_price, cs_sales_price, cs_ext_sales_price FROM catalog_sales) cs
      JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, i_category FROM item) it
        ON it.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
       AND it.i_category = 'Sports'
       AND cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.80 AND 1.00
      JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim) dd
        ON dd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT cr_order_number, cr_item_sk, cr_return_quantity, cr_return_amount, cr_reason_sk FROM catalog_returns) cr
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
      AND cr.cr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45)
    UNION
    SELECT dd.d_year, it.i_brand_id, it.i_class_id, it.i_category_id, it.i_manufact_id,
           ss.ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt,
           ss.ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt,0.0) AS sales_amt
    FROM (SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_quantity, ss_list_price, ss_sales_price, ss_ext_sales_price FROM store_sales) ss
      JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, i_category FROM item) it
        ON it.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
       AND it.i_category = 'Sports'
       AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.80 AND 1.00
      JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim) dd
        ON dd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_return_quantity, sr_return_amt, sr_reason_sk FROM store_returns) sr
        ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
      AND sr.sr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45)
    UNION
    SELECT dd.d_year, it.i_brand_id, it.i_class_id, it.i_category_id, it.i_manufact_id,
           ws.ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt,
           ws.ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt,0.0) AS sales_amt
    FROM (SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_order_number, ws_quantity, ws_list_price, ws_sales_price, ws_ext_sales_price FROM web_sales) ws
      JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, i_category FROM item) it
        ON it.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
       AND it.i_category = 'Sports'
       AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.80 AND 1.00
      JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim) dd
        ON dd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT wr_order_number, wr_item_sk, wr_return_quantity, wr_return_amt, wr_reason_sk FROM web_returns) wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
      AND wr.wr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45)
  ) sales_detail
  WHERE sales_detail.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
)

rewritten_query:
with customer_total_return as (
    select cr_returning_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk,
           ca_state as ctr_state,
           sum(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) as ctr_total_return
    from catalog_returns, date_dim, customer_address
    where cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
      and d_year = 1998
      and cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    group by cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),
avg_return as (
    select ctr_state,
           avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 as avg_ctr_total_return
    from customer_total_return
    group by ctr_state
)
select c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name,
       ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number,
       ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset,
       ca_location_type, ctr_total_return
from customer_total_return ctr1,
     avg_return,
     customer_address,
     customer
where ctr1.ctr_total_return > avg_return.avg_ctr_total_return
  and ctr1.ctr_state = avg_return.ctr_state
  and ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
  and ca_state = 'OR'
  and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
order by c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name,
         ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number,
         ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset,
         ca_location_type, ctr_total_return
limit 100;

rewritten_query:
with target_dates as (
    select d_date_sk
    from date_dim
    where d_month_seq in (select d_month_seq from date_dim where d_date in ('2002-02-09','2002-04-16','2002-07-16','2002-10-28'))
),
sr_items as (
    select i.i_item_id item_id, sum(sr.sr_return_quantity) sr_item_qty
    from store_returns sr
    join item i
      on sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
     and i.i_category in ('Home', 'Jewelry')
     and i.i_manager_id between 91 and 100
    join target_dates td
      on sr.sr_returned_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
     and sr.sr_return_amt / sr.sr_return_quantity between 271 and 300
     and sr.sr_reason_sk in (3, 20, 40, 43, 51)
    group by i.i_item_id
),
cr_items as (
    select i.i_item_id item_id, sum(cr.cr_return_quantity) cr_item_qty
    from catalog_returns cr
    join item i
      on cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
     and i.i_category in ('Home', 'Jewelry')
     and i.i_manager_id between 91 and 100
    join target_dates td
      on cr.cr_returned_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
     and cr.cr_return_amount / cr.cr_return_quantity between 271 and 300
     and cr.cr_reason_sk in (3, 20, 40, 43, 51)
    group by i.i_item_id
),
wr_items as (
    select i.i_item_id item_id, sum(wr.wr_return_quantity) wr_item_qty
    from web_returns wr
    join item i
      on wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
     and i.i_category in ('Home', 'Jewelry')
     and i.i_manager_id between 91 and 100
    join target_dates td
      on wr.wr_returned_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
     and wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity between 271 and 300
     and wr.wr_reason_sk in (3, 20, 40, 43, 51)
    group by i.i_item_id
)
select sr_items.item_id,
       sr_item_qty,
       sr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 sr_dev,
       cr_item_qty,
       cr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 cr_dev,
       wr_item_qty,
       wr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 wr_dev,
       (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 average
from sr_items
join cr_items on sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id
join wr_items on sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id

SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, ss_item_sk
      FROM store_sales
      WHERE ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
        AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.57 AND 0.77) ss
JOIN (SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_returned_date_sk
      FROM store_returns
      WHERE sr_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
        AND sr_item_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL) sr
  ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
 AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
JOIN (SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk
      FROM web_sales
      WHERE ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL) ws
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
 AND sr.sr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
 AND ss.ss_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_date + INTERVAL '90' day AS d_date_end
      FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND d_year = 1999) d1
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
      FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_date_sk IS NOT NULL) d2
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
 AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND d1.d_date_end
JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk
      FROM item
      WHERE i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND i_category IN ('Home', 'Men', 'Music')) i
  ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
 AND i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
 AND i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name,
             c_current_addr_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk
      FROM customer
      WHERE c_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND c_current_addr_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND c_current_hdemo_sk IS NOT NULL) c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
 AND c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
JOIN (SELECT ca_address_sk
      FROM customer_address
      WHERE ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND ca_state IN ('MS', 'NC', 'NM', 'OK', 'TN')) ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
JOIN (SELECT hd_demo_sk
      FROM household_demographics
      WHERE hd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20
        AND hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000') hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
ORDER BY cnt;
